audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text and wants.you[0] both label the split-bolt as 'Q (Tectonic Disruption)' — Tectonic Disruption is Vel'Koz's E knockup, not his Q. The splitting bolt is Plasma Fission (Q). wants.foe[1] labels the knockup itself as 'E (Organic Deconstruction)' — Organic Deconstruction is his Passive, not his E; the knockup is Tectonic Disruption (E). breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and it omits that Organic Deconstruction stacks (P) and his R deal true damage, bypassing armor/MR entirely (missingInteractions rule 27). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad copy-paste (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Per enemyKit, Q=Plasma Fission (splits), E=Tectonic Disruption (knockup), P=Organic Deconstruction (true-damage stacks), R=Life Form Disintegration Ray (true damage, 100/90/80s CD).
audit.corrected: Swapped the two mislabeled ability names, added the E cooldown number and the true-damage/resistance-bypass note, replaced the two copy-pasted bullets.
